lines.1: Now then, where was the drama-club room?
lines.2: Actually, I was starting to wonder whether Konoe would even accept me as help.
lines.3: If I invoked Otome's name, she'd probably do it reluctantly.
lines.6: 「The drama club... apparently started arguing after Konoe added new work.」
lines.8: Konoe running ahead of everyone--how easy to understand.
lines.9: She had a habit of charging forward alone when she got going.
lines.10: Sometimes everyone else simply couldn't keep up. Apparently this was another one of those times.
lines.14: 「I'm glad to have a little brother like you.」
lines.16: 「I need to return to disciplinary-committee work. Sorry for stopping you.」
lines.19: 「This feels a little like middle school repeating itself.」
lines.20: 「But after she asked me that directly, I should at least try.」
lines.21: And if I did the job properly, the Princess might like me more too.
lines.22: I tried to think as positively as possible and headed for the drama-club room.
lines.24: 「--So, I'm Leo Tsushima from Class 2-C, sent over by the executive committee. Nice to meet you.」
lines.25: I introduced myself in front of just under twenty members.
lines.28: 「Why are you here? I don't remember asking for help.」
lines.29: 「President Konoe. Under the current circumstances, I calculate that having even one more helper is better. My computer reaches the same conclusion.」
lines.30: 「President Konoe is the one who increased the workload in the first place, like.」
lines.33: 「And we were short exactly one man's worth of labor for that job...」
lines.34: 「Damn. I need to act like an adult here.」
lines.37: 「Understood. Thank you for coming to help.」
lines.40: Konoe had calmly switched into club-president mode and accepted me.
lines.41: Which meant the situation was heavy enough to have pushed her that far.
lines.44: 「We're seriously grateful for the help, like.」
lines.45: I sat beside Yamada and Yoshida--Student Z.
lines.46: It seemed I was genuinely welcome as reinforcement.
lines.49: 「She's meticulous and seems able to handle anything cleanly, so it's hard to argue with her.」
lines.50: 「About the only bad thing is that she sleeps terribly, like.」
lines.55: 「All right, everyone. Let's summarize the drama club's situation for the Sports and Martial Arts Festival.」
lines.56: 「First, normal rehearsal continues, though at reduced frequency.」
lines.58: 「Next, practice for our festival duty: receiving outside visitors and handing out pamphlets.」
lines.60: 「Then there's the new work helping decorate the panels.」
lines.64: Apparently this was the part they didn't accept.
lines.66: 「It's a place that gets dirty easily, so it already gets routine cleaning.」
lines.67: 「But we're welcoming lots of visitors, so it has to be spotless.」
lines.68: 「And that is a lot of work.」
lines.69: A girl shot to her feet.
lines.70: 「That's why! Why did you agree to this too? We're already completely overloaded!」
lines.71: 「Exactly. Even if we work all three days of the holiday starting tomorrow, we'll barely finish everything except the gate cleaning in time.」
lines.72: 「I had plans to eat with my elite father during the break...」
lines.73: 「Of course I know better than anyone that we're already right at the limit. I'm the president.」
lines.74: 「But if we work hard here, maybe we'll receive a larger club budget. Then we can aim even higher.」
lines.75: 「That's why I'm proposing that we all push through together.」
lines.77: 「I understand how you feel, but we don't have any open time left, like.」
lines.78: 「Then we'll work through the three-day break and stay late into the night! How about that!?」
lines.79: 「I have cram school at night, like.」
lines.80: 「I need to check the stock market too. That's important personal time, and I don't want to cut it.」
lines.81: 「Why? This is our chance to show what we're capable of and increase the club budget!」
lines.82: 「One late night maybe, but grinding nonstop for three or four days is impossible.」
lines.83: 「My elite father says efficiency drops if you work continuously without rest!」
lines.84: 「Why? Don't any of you want to aim higher? We've worked this hard already. Push through here and let's reach the next level!」
lines.85: Konoe launched into an impassioned appeal.
lines.86: ...But contrary to her passion, the atmosphere around her grew colder.
lines.88: I sighed before I could stop myself.
lines.89: Now I understood the situation completely.
lines.90: It really was Konoe charging ahead again.
lines.91: Just like back then... in middle school.
lines.92: The last memory Konoe and I shared from those days.
